Dr. Daniel Physical Therapist has his Bachelors Degree in Exercise Science, Doctorate in Physical Therapy and Certification in Manual Therapy. He has treated thousands of patients around the US traveling as a PT doing contracts for physical therapy companies. He is exceptionally grateful to help people heal and get back to their normal lives. 
These videos are to help you with the process of healing, giving the information and tools to regain your life. They come from education and experience treating patients who have had positive results. He hopes that these videos will also give you those same positive results.
